title: For a surjective open continuous map the closures, closed sets, opens and locally closed sets are exactly the preimages
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the list of exactness properties of a surjective open continuous map (author lemma at source lines 770-782, label lemma-open-morphism-quotient-topology): preimages commute with closures, and closedness, openness and local closedness of subsets of the target are tested on preimages, which in particular makes the map submersive. The proof (source lines 784-798) proves the closure statement by an explicit point argument in which the openness of the map is what lets one push an open neighbourhood forward (proof lines 785-790), and then derives the other three from it, using the restriction to the closure of the preimage for the locally closed case (proof lines 795-797). H2.
